title: Anattā; ajjhattam
text: 3 Cakkhum bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Sotam anattā || || Ghānam anattā || || Jivhā anattā || Kāyo anattā || 8 Mano anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
